cohort: 302 newborns whose mothers planned to exclusively breastfeed
finding: Infants born by Cesarean section, born between 9 p.m. and 10 a.m., and those with a hospital stay longer than 24 hours were more likely to receive formula supplementation before discharge.
mod_finding: Infants born via Cesarean section were significantly more likely to receive formula supplementation than those born vaginally (51% vs. 31%).
